hikes.name: Mount McLoughlin
hikes.blurb: Southern Oregon's highest peak by trail: a steep, rocky climb to a summit with Shasta and Crater Lake's rim in view.

hikes.name: Sky Lakes Basin
hikes.blurb: An easy walk to a cluster of forest lakes, the start of the Sky Lakes Wilderness's long chain.

hikes.name: Upper Klamath Lake
hikes.blurb: From Spence Mountain Trailhead, an 8.4-mile round trip to Upper Klamath Lake, with about 950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Cliff Lake
hikes.blurb: From Seven Lakes Trailhead, a 10.4-mile round trip to Cliff Lake, with about 2,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Devils Peak
hikes.blurb: From Seven Lakes Trailhead, a 10.7-mile round trip to the top of Devils Peak (7,562 ft), with about 2,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lee Peak
hikes.blurb: From Seven Lakes Trailhead, an 11.0-mile round trip to the top of Lee Peak (7,361 ft), with about 2,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Island Lake
hikes.blurb: From Blue Canyon Trailhead, an 11.8-mile round trip to Island Lake, with about 1,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Pelican Butte
hikes.blurb: From Cold Springs Trailhead, a 9.9-mile round trip to the top of Pelican Butte (8,016 ft), with about 2,300 feet of climbing.
